overview: Against the Austrian Attack set-up with pawns on d4, e4 and f4, Black strikes with ...c5 and ...Qa5+ to harass the centre and keep White from consolidating. After 5.Bd2 or 5.c3 White tries to hold the centre with a big pawn mass, while Black's queen on a5 and bishop on g7 pressure e5, d4 and c3. Play is double-edged, and Black's early queen can end up offside if White coordinates the minor pieces.

white_ideas.idea: Hold the broad centre with c3, Bd3, O-O and meet ...cxd4 with Nxd4 or cxd4
Push e5 to gain space and cramp the Black bishop

black_ideas.idea: Undermine d4 with ...cxd4 and ...Qb6, then use the long diagonal
Use ...Qa5+ and ...Nc6 to harass the pawn centre before castling

typical_structures.structure: White pawn mass on d4, e4, f4 against a Black fianchettoed bishop and early queen activity

character.notes: Big White centre against early queen sorties; unbalanced and tactical.

gambit.notes: No material is offered; ...cxd4 simply exchanges pawns.

soundness.notes: Generally regarded as playable for Black, but the early queen carries risk.

structure.notes: Black attacks the centre with a c-pawn exchange, giving a half-open c-file; White keeps the centre pawns.

approach.notes: Rarely played by strong players, chosen mainly for surprise.

level.notes: Needs good judgment about when to play ...cxd4 and how to place the queen.

sublines_that_differ.name: Pteranodon
sublines_that_differ.how: Queen sortie after White supports the centre with c3.

sublines_that_differ.name: Grand Prix Pterodactyl
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 g6 2. Nc3 Bg7 3. f4 c5 4. Nf3 Qa5
sublines_that_differ.how: Reached from the Grand Prix move order.

character.reason: White's broad centre against Black's early queen sorties leaves little margin for error.

gambit.reason: No material has been given up.

soundness.reason: Black's set-up is playable even if the queen is exposed.

structure.reason: The c-pawn exchange leaves a half-open c-file for Black against White's centre.

approach.reason: Strong players seldom choose the Pterodactyl.

level.reason: Judgement-based play without long forced theory.

plans.reason: Black lets White build a centre and attacks it with queen and bishop.
